[ISBK.1.8] **`query_at` (optional, ABI v5).** Reads the aggregation **as of an
explicit monotonic-clock `now_ns`** ([LTIM.2.8.2]), not as of the last absorbed
sample — the read-only discount + open-interval extrapolation the signal
aggregations need when a rule queries after a quiet gap ([LSIG.2.5]). Every rule
read of a backing that carries it goes through it, at the step's held sample
([LTIM.2.8.4]). The hook requires `now_ns` no earlier than the row's last
absorb, so libds raises `now_ns` to that absorb when a sample stamped ahead of
the clock is the newest. A NULL hook means reads land as of the last absorb,
through `query`.
